name: Relinquished / Thousand-Eyes
note: Relinquished / Thousand-Eyes (GOAT-legal Pegasus engine) — docs/goat-decks.md §3.3. Names validated against cards.cdb.
manual:
GOAT-legal Pegasus engine (Relinquished / Thousand-Eyes).

**Game plan:** absorb the opponent's best monster twice over (Relinquished, then TER) and lock the board.

**Key cards / engine:** Black Illusion Ritual + Relinquished; Metamorphosis token → TER.

**How to pilot / combo lines:**
- **Search the ritual:** `Senju of the Thousand Hands` (search a Ritual Monster on summon) and `Sonic Bird` (search a Ritual Spell) assemble `Relinquished` + `Black Illusion Ritual` — whose text tributes "a monster … whose Level is 1 or more" [CDB], so a `Scapegoat` token or a searcher pays for it.
- **`Relinquished` absorb line:** "target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target … ATK/DEF become equal … any battle damage you take from battles involving this card inflicts equal effect damage to your opponent" [CDB] — steal their beater and turn incoming damage into burn.
- **The bigger swing:** `Metamorphosis` a `Scapegoat` token → `Thousand-Eyes Restrict`, which absorbs a monster *and* freezes the board [CDB]. `Premature Burial`/`Call of the Haunted` recycle a used Relinquished. `Thousand-Eyes Idol` is only here as searchable Fusion material — keep it to one.

**Weaknesses:** Relinquished is a Ritual — dead without both halves; `Nobleman of Crossout`/battle removal on the absorbing monster; backrow removal on your traps opens the grind.
